
{{alias}}( n, x )
    Evaluates the Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind for
    a degree `n` at a value `x`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    n: number
        Degree of the polynomial.

    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Polynomial value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 0.0, 0.5 )
    1.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, -0.5 )
    -0.5
    > y = {{alias}}( 5.0, 0.5 )
    0.5
    > y = {{alias}}( -2.5, 0.5 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0, 0.5 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN, 1.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
